systems.country_label: fiches mensuelles de collecte des données des faits d'état civil
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration du territoire et de la Décentralisation, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: civil-status officers of the communes (mayors of Logone occidental and Logone oriental trained), transmitting monthly to the ministry

note: A workshop for the mayors of the two Logone provinces on transmitting civil-status data to the centre by monthly forms; it names insufficient infrastructure and no harmonised reporting mechanism but states nothing on the connection of commune offices.
